Quick answer

Acosta Pro Aluminum Screen serves Sarasota County, Manatee County and Charlotte County in Southwest Florida, including Sarasota, Bradenton, Venice, North Port, Port Charlotte, Punta Gorda, Lakewood Ranch and Englewood. If your property is within about 45 miles of Sarasota, call 941-565-5576 — we almost certainly cover it.
